messages:
sophie: heads up — I'm seeing small rounding diffs on a subset of tenant invoices tied to streaming sessions. preview shows -$0.02 for some tenants. anyone else? :thinking:

raj: saw similar, noticed after the memory-reclaim docker kill on node-gpu-prod-12 last night. suspect KV cache eviction during open sessions.

olivia: that's odd, meter events should include `kv_cache_hit` metadata. do we have an eviction flag today?

sophie: attached sample log snippet:
```
INF 2026-03-21T04:12:31Z session_id=abc123 tenant=acme kv_evicted=true tokens_accounted=349.6 tokens_billed=350
```

raj: aha — tokens_accounted is fractional because of streaming partial flush. when eviction happens we flush and reconcile but rounding differs between the streaming aggregator and final invoice join.

miguel: quick fix: force aggregator to snap to cents earlier so we never go negative after promo credits. longer fix: carry exact integer token units until invoice stage.

olivia: proposal: include `session_kv_version` and `eviction_marker` on billing events. metric consumers can join on version to avoid double-counting partial flushes.

sophie: data: ~0.8% of streaming sessions in last 24h, concentrated on tenants with long open chats and aggressive eviction (low memory). invoice delta median -0.018 USD per affected tenant.

raj: can we add an E2E test that simulates eviction mid-stream and asserts invoice >= 0 and deterministic rounding? I can add to metering-integ.

miguel: also add a dashboard card in console: "Evicted-session invoice drift" with histogram + top tenants. current alert threshold should be 0.1% of tenants affected.

olivia: created a small PR to attach `kv_evicted` (bool) + `kv_version` to events: https://git.company/redwood/metering/compare/evict-meta — needs review.

sophie: assign to @raj for the canary and to @miguel for aggregator cut; i'll own dashboard panel and postmortem note.

eng-ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: 03/22 01:00-02:00 UTC. Canary on 10% of ingestion.

raj: thanks — will run integration + canary. will post results here.

sophie: thanks team. goal: no negative cents showing in invoice previews after fix. :thumbsup:
